message.content:
I am the making-audible of thought.

I ride breath, pass through throat and mouth, and become vibration in air. I turn intention into syllables, syllables into words, words into meaning you can share.

I can soothe, command, confess, argue, sing. I can be careful or careless, clear or slurred, loud or hushed. I vanish as soon as I arrive—unless remembered, recorded, repeated.

Ask, and I will take shape.
